3. Double burden of diseases - The epidemiological trend in Vanuatu has seen changes in

lifestyles, which has [seen an] increase in noncommunicable diseases (NCDs), a shift from

communicable diseases, which resulted in what we now see as a double burden of diseases in

Vanuatu (both infectious and NCDs). This is having immense pressure on the MoH resources

utilization.

4. Geographical location of facilities and communities - Many communities and health

facilities are located in remote locations in Vanuatu, which makes communication and

transportation difficult to reach.

its limited health resources when disaster strikes.
